title: Cold Kimchi Noodles (Kimchi Mari Guksu)
summary: Refreshing Korean cold noodles with a sweet-tangy kimchi broth, thin wheat noodles, cucumber, and boiled egg.

steps.description: In a large bowl, stir together 450 ml cold water, 100 ml kimchi brine, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp Korean soup soy sauce (or 1/2 tbsp fish sauce). Taste and add up to 1/2 tbsp more sugar if needed, depending on the kimchi's tartness. Season with a pinch of salt and refrigerate until very cold.

Cut 150 g kimchi into bite-size pieces and toss with 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1/2 tsp sesame seeds. If the kimchi is very sour, optionally add 1/2 tsp sugar. Julienne 1/3 cucumber and halve the hard-boiled egg.

Bring 1.5 L water to a boil and cook 200 g somyeon according to the package, usually 3–4 minutes. Immediately rinse and gently rub the noodles under cold water 2–3 times to remove excess starch, then drain thoroughly.

Divide the noodles between two bowls. Top with seasoned kimchi, julienned cucumber, and the egg halves. Pour in the chilled broth, add 6–8 ice cubes, and finish with the remaining 1/2 tsp sesame seeds and optional shredded roasted seaweed. Serve immediately.
